title: The auto-inhibition mechanism of transcription factor Ets-1 induced by phosphorylation on the intrinsically disordered region.
authors: Ning, Shangbo; Chao, Hong-Jun; Li, Shuangli; Zhou, Rui; Zou, Lei; Zhang, Xu; Liu, Jun; Yan, Dazhong; Duan, Mojie
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子模拟与生化实验结合，揭示磷酸化修饰对转录因子Ets-1无序区自抑制DNA结合能力的分子机制，聚焦TF-DNA互作调控，方法上采用MD模拟与自由能景观分析，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: As the most abundant post-translation modifications (PTMs), the phosphorylation usually occurred on the intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs). The regulation on the structures and interactions of IDRs induced by phosphorylation is critical to the function performing. The eukaryotic transcription factor 1 (Ets-1) is a member of transcription factor family, which participates in many important biological processes. The DNA-binding ability of Ets-1 is auto-inhibited by a disordered serine-rich region (SRR) on the Ets-1. The inhibition ability of SRR is greatly enhanced by the phosphorylation of the serine on the SRR. Nevertheless, the molecular mechanisms of the phosphorylation regulation on the structure and activity of Ets-1 are still unclear and under debates. By using both of the molecular simulations and biochemical experiments, we studied the molecule mechanism of phosphorylation regulation on the auto-inhibition of the Ets-1. The reasons of stabilization of Ets-1 core by phosphorylation on SRR region were elucidated. More important, the free energy landscapes (FEL) show that both of the steric hindrance and allosteric regulation are responsible for the DNA-binding inhibitory induced by phosphorylation, but the steric effects contribute greater than the allosteric regulation. The phosphorylation not only enhances the electrostatic interactions to facilitate the steric impedance, but also promotes the formation of hydrophobic residue clusters, which provide major driven force for the allosteric regulation. The structural basis of auto-inhibition of Ets-1 induced by the phosphorylation revealed in this study would great help the developing of inhibitor for the cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 作为最丰富的翻译后修饰（PTMs），磷酸化通常发生在 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 上。磷酸化对 IDRs 结构和相互作用的调控对其功能执行至关重要。真核转录因子 1 (Ets-1) 是转录因子家族的一员，参与许多重要的生物过程。Ets-1 的 DNA 结合能力被其上的一个无序丝氨酸富集区（SRR）自动抑制。SRR 上丝氨酸的磷酸化大大增强了其抑制能力。然而，磷酸化调控 Ets-1 结构和活性的分子机制仍不清楚且存在争议。通过分子模拟和生化实验，我们研究了磷酸化调控 Ets-1 自动抑制的分子机制。阐明了 SRR 区域磷酸化稳定 Ets-1 核心的原因。更重要的是，自由能景观（FEL）显示，空间位阻和别构调控均参与了磷酸化诱导的 DNA 结合抑制，但空间效应贡献大于别构调控。磷酸化不仅增强了静电相互作用以促进空间阻碍，还促进了疏水残基簇的形成，这为别构调控提供了主要驱动力。本研究揭示的磷酸化诱导 Ets-1 自动抑制的结构基础将极大有助于癌症治疗抑制剂的开发。
